title: Export for Cursor
description: Generate skills for Cursor. Project-level targets are .cursor/skills/ or .agents/skills/. Global targets are ~/.cursor/skills/ or ~/.agents/skills/. Cursor also loads compatible Claude and Codex skill folders.

title: Export for Claude
description: Generate skills for Claude Code and Claude Desktop. Project-level target is .claude/skills/. Global target is ~/.claude/skills/.

title: Export for OpenAI Codex
description: Generate skills for OpenAI Codex. Project-level targets are .codex/skills/ and .agents/skills/. Global targets are ~/.codex/skills/ and ~/.agents/skills/.

title: Export for GitHub Copilot
description: Generate skills for GitHub Copilot. Project-level targets are .github/skills/ or .agents/skills/. Global targets are ~/.copilot/skills/ or ~/.agents/skills/.
